architect (s/4hana) sr. manager, enterprise architecture & strategy - individual contributor (p5) raytheon digital technology - data analytics & ai remote position - domestic us locations only we are embarking on a multi‑year transformation from sap ecc to sap s/4hana. as a data architect, you will define and evolve the enterprise data architecture that supports this journey, ensuring we can blend and report across ecc and s/4hana in parallel until full migration is complete. you’ll design the canonical data model, integration patterns, and bridge reporting strategy that unify data from migrated and non‑migrated business areas—delivering trustworthy, timely insights to leaders and frontline teams. this senior individual contributor partners closely with product managers, enterprise architects, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to set direction, document standards, and guide solution teams across the full lifecycle—from planning and design through deployment and operations. you will use formal architecture and strategy methods and practices, such as togaf, to depict business strategy, problems, needs and structure before solution architecture and design occurs. you will also have responsibility for continuously developing reference architectures, data architectures, personas, use cases, landscape models, repository and knowledgebases to accelerate future architecture engagements. what you will do own the enterprise data architecture for the ecc → s/4hana transition, defining principles, reference architectures, and guardrails for data domains analytics (e.g., consolidated financials, inventory, order fulfillment), including semantic layers and data virtualization/replication as appropriate. model canonical and system‑specific data (conceptual, logical, physical) and establish golden sources, conformed dimensions, data standards, and naming/versioning conventions. define integration patterns (e.g., slt/odp/cdc, apis, files, calculations; design security and data‑access patterns; guide dashboard/story design standards. oversee etl/elt pipelines using sap businessobjects data services (bods) and modern orchestration related field and minimum 7 years' experience experience with the sap ecc data model (core modules and common customizations/extensions). experience with the sap s/4hana data model, including cds views, embedded analytics concepts, and differences from ecc. experience in data architecture/engineering with end‑to‑end ownership of enterprise data platforms. u.s. citizenship is required, as only aerospace systems, pratt & whitney, and raytheon. its 185,000 employees enable the company to operate at the edge of known science as they imagine and deliver solutions that push the boundaries in quantum physics, electric propulsion, directed energy, hypersonics, avionics and cybersecurity. the company, formed in 2020 through the combination of raytheon company and the united technologies corporation aerospace businesses, is headquartered in arlington, va. we’re seeking a highly skilled oracle cloud engineer who is energized by solving complex technical challenges and building cloud solutions that scale. this role is deeply hands-on , blending architectural vision with practical engineering execution. you’ll design, build, secure, and optimize our oci platform using oracle policy, role based access, oci recipes, and oci functions, in modern devops and automated oci environment. you’ll work as part of a team of oci engineers, collaborating closely to drive cloud innovation and deliver high-quality solutions for our internal customers. what you will do in this oracle cloud infrastructure (oci) role, you’ll help shape strategy, operational direction, and apply hands-on oci network and infrastructure engineering to drive real impact across our oracle cloud platform. design and develop core oci landing zone automation to support scalable, secure, and compliant cloud environments. implement centralized landing zone management using oci-native services such as cloud guard, logging, audit, and identity domains. infrastructure as code development: build and maintain oci infrastructure using terraform, oracle cloud cli, ansible, and api integrations. develop reusable modules, manage version-controlled deployments, and support environment-specific configurations. drive a self-service, automation-first mindset to empower stakeholders with secure, scalable, and efficient cloud deployment capabilities. providing automation for self-service provisioning and management across both traditional iaas workloads and modern serverless applications. experience designing, implementing, and automating oci networking architectures; hands on experience with virtual cloud networks (vcns), subnets, route tables, security lists, and network security groups (nsgs) to ensure secure, scalable, and high-performance connectivity; demonstratable experience with gateways such as internet gateways, nat gateways, service gateways, and dynamic routing gateways (drgs) for hub-and-spoke topologies, vcn peering, and hybrid connectivity with on-premises networks via fastconnect or vpn. design and implement automated guardrails to enforce security and configuration standards across oci environments; develop deployment automation and auto-remediation workflows using oci cloud guard, functions, and iam policies; build critical event detection and notification systems leveraging oci monitoring (detectors and responders), logging, and alarms to ensure rapid response to anomalies and misconfigurations. experience implementing least privilege access controls using oci iam policies, dynamic groups, and compartment hierarchies to restrict resource permissions effectively; hands-on work integrating oci identity domains with enterprise identity systems such as active directory or ldap through federation protocols, scim provisioning, and identity bridges for seamless user lifecycle management; proven skills configuring cloud-native access patterns including federated sso, multi-factor authentication enforcement, and api gateway authorizations within oci environments. ensure oci services comply with internal security policies and external standards such as nist 800-53, cmmc, and other regulatory frameworks. integrate oci with enterprise networks and core it services to ensure seamless connectivity and interoperability. diagnose and resolve technical issues, document procedures, and recommend architectural improvements to enhance reliability and performance. qualifications you must have typically requires a degree in science, technology, engineering or mathematics across engineering and business teams. qualifications we prefer experience designing and governing medium / large enterprise-scale oracle oci environments. background in cloud security, including oci policy, role based access control, and identity governance. experience building or maturing ci/cd pipelines, observability frameworks, and automated testing practices. prior leadership experience
